backlink_pages.title: Runbook — SSO Certificate Rotation
backlink_pages.author: Sam Ortiz
backlink_pages.excerpt: Scope Board SSO can fail when the IdP returns a mixed-case NameID domain (NMB-137). Portal-only login breaks are NMS-112. A dedicated verification runbook for agents after cert rotation is requested

content.text: After IdP certificate rotations, portal SSO breakages show up as a spike in NMS login tickets. Engineers re-derive the verification steps from memory; we need a durable runbook.

Ship a runbook that covers: confirming the new x509 in the IdP metadata URL, updating the portal SSO cert PEM in admin, purging the metadata cache key sso:idp_meta:{workspace_id}, running the /auth/sso/self-check endpoint, and a five-minute canary with a test user. Include rollback (restore previous PEM) and who to page if self-check fails in production.
